meta.title: Mia in Chiang Mai
meta.textType: story: names of people and places

paragraphs: Mia went to Chiang Mai with Lily's family, and everything was new to her. Aunt Sue lived on Blue Street, near the river. On Saturday morning, she took the girls to Moon Square. "There is a funfair in the square today," said Aunt Sue. "I want to do some shopping first." "Wait for me by the big clock," she said. Then she went into a shop.

Mia looked at the funfair. She saw red balloons and a toy train. "Let's go and look," said Lily. "Aunt Sue said, 'Wait by the clock,'" said Mia. "We can come back," said Lily. They went into the funfair and looked at the balloons. Then they walked out of the square and down the wrong street. "This isn't Moon Square," said Mia. "This is Red Street." "Where is the clock?" asked Lily. Mia was afraid, and she took Lily's hand.

A woman in a yellow hat stood by a shop. "Excuse me," said Mia. "Where is Moon Square?" "It's at the end of this street," said the woman. "It's very near." The girls ran to the end of the street. The sun was hot, and there were many people in the square. Aunt Sue stood by the big clock. "Where were you?" she asked. "We went to the funfair. Then we went down the wrong street," said Lily. "I'm sorry, Aunt Sue." Aunt Sue smiled and gave the girls two balloons. "I like Chiang Mai," said Mia. Now she was not afraid, and Lily was happy, too.
